fields.description: ROM build/company stamp: '45 (XLV) / FORTY FIVE CO.,LTD.' plus NUL terminator, written at the start of SRAM.
fields.evidence: Save offsets 0x00..0x1E hold '45 (XLV) / FORTY FIVE CO.,LTD.' + NUL, verified byte-for-byte against samples/baseline.sav. Staged into SRAM through the ROM block-copy path (memcpy helper FUN_0802ec30, cf. ROM-string staging in FUN_08024d78/FUN_08024f34). No MMIO-labeled SRAM writer exists in decomp/decompiled.c.gz.

fields.description: 32-bit zero status word in the SRAM header area (reads 0 in the live-captured save).
fields.evidence: Save offsets 0x30..0x33 read as u32 0 in samples/baseline.sav; consistent with zero-fill initialization via memset helper FUN_0802ec90 (cf. buffer clears in FUN_08023124 and FUN_080234ac).

fields.description: First of three cleared single-byte record status flags spaced at a regular 0x584 stride.
fields.evidence: Save offset 0x290 is 0x00 in samples/baseline.sav; forms a 0x584-stride triple with offsets 0x814 and 0xD98. Cleared-flag pattern consistent with zero-fill helper FUN_0802ec90; surrounding bytes are erased 0xFF so no wider struct is observable.

fields.description: Second of three cleared single-byte record status flags (stride 0x584 from record_status_a).
fields.evidence: Save offset 0x814 is 0x00 in samples/baseline.sav (0x814 - 0x290 = 0x584). Same cleared-flag evidence as record_status_a via memset helper FUN_0802ec90.
fields.name: record_status_b

fields.description: Third of three cleared single-byte record status flags (stride 0x584 from record_status_b).
fields.evidence: Save offset 0xD98 is 0x00 in samples/baseline.sav (0xD98 - 0x814 = 0x584). Same cleared-flag evidence as record_status_a via memset helper FUN_0802ec90.
fields.name: record_status_c
